_: The home worlds a people can arise on.
archetypes: one row per world type: key, desc (how the legends say it), weight in the draw, the base levels (mil, sur, soc), domains (research tilt), traits every species from the world gets.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

archetypes.desc: an ocean world with scattered islands
an arid world of salt flats and canyons
a tidally locked world, habitable only along its twilight band
a heavy world of crushing gravity
a small, light world with a thin sky
a hothouse world under a crushing, poisonous sky
an ocean sealed beneath a shell of ice
the cloud decks of a gas giant
a moon kneaded by tides, all fire and sulphur
a dim world huddled close to a brown dwarf companion
